purpose: Retained provenance for mem-v1 engineering replays; this file distinguishes literal current consumers from explicitly admitted inference north-star shapes.

source_evidence.fact: DynamicBitSet stores an injected mem::AllocatorRef and routes growth and teardown through it.
HttpServeOptions freezes a 4 KiB initial block, 64 KiB maximum ordinary block and 64 KiB dedicated-allocation threshold.
One keep-alive owner reuses ordinary blocks, clears after handler/response destruction and releases pathological retained capacity.
Scheduler owns three guarded-stack pools and uses its injected allocator for detached-driver storage.
ObjectPool exposes fixed hard capacity, non-blocking acquisition and move-only scoped return over the thread-safe ConcurrentBlockPool core.
The inference engine consumes host allocator/arena/pool mechanisms while model, KV and serving policy remain above mem.
